description: Compare estimates with observed delivery, corrections, floor misses, and cost; file findings as Feedback issues.

classify.description: Feedback issue to classify by the highest layer that can fix its correction for good (needs --layer and --reason); writes no report.

criterion.description: With --classify and a layer other than prose: the Completion Goal criterion of the Story filed for it, `[evidence] state: …; expected: …`, whose proof is the new type, invariant, lint rule, test, or review surface.

layer.description: With --classify: codebase (a type, invariant, or boundary), check (a lint rule, test, or CI check), prose (skill or AGENTS.md guidance), or review (what is surfaced for human review).

ledger.description: Ledger commit to read; default the ledger tip.

not-catchable.description: With --classify: why no type, invariant, lint rule, or test can catch it; required for prose and review, and lets evolve rewrite a skill for a codebase or check correction.

out.description: Also write the report to this file.

reason.description: With --classify: why this is the highest layer that can fix the correction for good.

replay.description: Regenerate a report from the GitHub inputs snapshot at this ledger path (retro/<date>/…inputs.json); files nothing.

since.description: Window start (YYYY-MM-DD UTC or RFC 3339); default the cursor of the newest retro report on the ledger, else 7 days back.
